Wedding Catering: Describe guest capacity, tasting, live counters and serving staff for each function.
Party Catering: Describe party types, small-event packages, children's menus, snacks and beverages.
Corporate Catering: Describe meeting meals, packed lunches, recurring contracts, delivery schedules and invoicing.
Home Catering: Describe minimum portions, delivery or home cooking and customer kitchen requirements.
Outdoor Catering: Describe travel limits, mobile cooking, power/water requirements, venue access and weather backup.

policies: Catering booking, quality and damage-claim policy
